measurementNotes: Native cycles sum QueryThreadCycleTime deltas for completed service tasks in the 1400-tick window. Observed worker CPU ms are JVM thread-time deltas. Exclusive phase times, service charge and service wait measure elapsed time.

Worker allocated bytes come from ThreadMXBean. Stack-specific allocation values are JFR sampling weights in bytes. Host background data covers other Java processes present at both endpoints of each sample window.

Temperature tolerance is max(1 degree C, 5% of the absolute baseline distance from local natural temperature) for the same probe and sample tick relative to ignition. The fixed-work replay compares each intermediate geometry Section set and unresolved-routes flag exactly.
The 68 unique Forge tests come from the first combined run plus retest of two subsets of those same namespaces. No long-run endurance claim.
